image_description: A high-angle view of a massive coastal cliff face (resembling the Cliffs of Moher) dropping steeply into a dark, churning ocean. The cliff top is covered in lush green grass, while the vertical rock face shows distinct horizontal stratification and weathering. White sea foam crashes against the base of the cliffs. In the immediate foreground right, there is a blurry wooden fence post and wire, suggesting the photo was taken from a designated viewing area.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The wooden post and wire in the bottom right corner are significantly out of focus compared to the rest of the image. While this mimics photographic depth-of-field, in AI generation, extreme localized blur can sometimes mask structural inconsistencies or 'melting' boundaries. It is noticeable but likely intentional stylistic blur.

The white sea foam has a slightly repetitive, 'stamped' pattern rather than organic randomness. The transition between the dark water and the white foam lacks some fine-grained turbulent detail, appearing slightly smudged or painterly upon close inspection.

To inspect the blurry foreground object for boundary bleeding and ensure the cliff edge against the sky is sharp and physically continuous.
